correctness.rationale: The exact update multiplier is (sqrt(v_{n+1})-epsilon)/(sqrt(v_{n+1})+epsilon). Its strict magnitude below one when x!=0 forces |x_n| decreasing; geometric averaging forces v_n to the squared limiting gradient; a positive limit contradicts strict contraction. Thus x_n,v_n->0; either finite hit or eventual negative multiplier. The nontrivial memory tracking lemma follows by unrolling v_{n+1}, bounding old history with rho in (sqrt(beta),1), and dominated convergence so v_{n+1}/(a^2x_n^2)->1. Reciprocal increment of |x| tends to 2a/epsilon. Cesaro implies amplitude and memory constants. Independent numerical iteration at a=2,epsilon=3,beta=.6,n=80000 gives n|x_n|=0.74869, n^2v_n=2.24229 versus limits .75,2.25. Boundary initial x=0 and finite-hit handled.
